_comment: Fragments the agent's questions are assembled from, one form inserted into the reply card.
Not a whole card: how many questions there are, and how many options each has, is only known
when the agent asks, so what can be written down ahead of time is the shape of each piece.
The {} placeholders are filled in two different ways, deliberately. The label ones —
{selectHint}, {otherHint}, {submitText} — are configuration, substituted into this file as
text by FeishuProperties.QuestionText. The rest carry what the model wrote, and are set on the
parsed JSON instead, so a question containing a quote cannot break the card.
